description: The dev run's permissions, plus the sidecar spawn: the checkout's Python runs sidecar/main.py. `cmd` takes no validator, so the interpreter is named by a path the shell plugin resolves at run time: $HOME/zugzwang/.venv/bin/python, a checkout at ~/zugzwang with its venv (README). A checkout elsewhere edits this one line. The packaged (beta) build uses capabilities/beta.json instead. tauri.conf.json must list ["default"]: with no list Tauri enables every file in capabilities/, beta.json's zugzwang-sidecar entry ($RESOURCE/sidecar/…) is found first, and the dev spawn fails with os error 2 (fix/dev-launch, 2026-11-13; src/dev_spawn_test.rs).
